summary: Saia, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 2, 2026, under Item 8.01 Other Events, attaching a press release that provides LTL shipment and tonnage data for April and May 2026. The filing contains operational metrics only—shipments per workday rose 5.6% (April) and 3.7% (May) year-over-year; tonnage per workday increased 6.9% and 8.4%, respectively. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event is announced. This is a routine current report disclosing monthly operating statistics with no transactional terms, board actions, advisors, or structural mechanics. What to watch: continued LTL volume trends as a proxy for demand.
